stops.name: Parque natural de Oyambre
stops.detail: The Oyambre Natural Park is a Spanish protected space situated in the western coastal area of Cantabria. It has 5758 hectares of extension and are spread across the municipalities of Copillas, San Vicente de la Barquera, Udías, Valdáliga and Val de San Vicente, in La Marina.
